questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Bluetooth LE and GATT”?
options: ESP32 family members do not all have the same radios and peripherals.
GATT organizes data into services and characteristics.
ESP-IDF selects the chip target before building.
The ESP32 name alone does not guarantee pin or radio compatibility; check the exact part.
questions.answer: GATT organizes data into services and characteristics.
questions.explanation:
GATT organizes data into services and characteristics.
Why: BLE GATT exposes data through services and characteristics. Advertising, connections, MTU, and power behavior vary by chip and SDK; define access control for each characteristic.

The BLE sketch uses the Arduino-ESP32 BLE library, whose headers and API vary by core version. ESP-IDF's GATT API has a different callback and lifecycle model; this sketch does not claim source compatibility.
